settings.intro_highlight: The Equipro Mini Cabi is the gold standard in compact towel hygiene, engineered for high-traffic aesthetic clinics and spas. This professional-grade unit combines rapid thermal heating with integrated UV sterilization to ensure every treatment begins with a safe, soothing, and premium experience.
settings.custom_description: The Mini Cabi is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including Estheticians, Skincare Specialists, and Clinical Spa Technicians. Its heavy-duty, compact design targets treatment room congestion and operational friction during back-to-back appointments, enabling sharper focus on service execution and client relaxation. Whether you are performing hot towel compresses, facial prep protocols, or hygienic tool sanitation, this clinical device adjusts to your multi-technician adaptability with constant thermal regulation and instant-response sterilization.
settings.subtitle: Engineered for Precise Thermal Hygiene & Compact Station Efficiency
settings.secondary_description: Structural integrity and mechanical reliability are central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the heating consistency and UV lamp lifespan of Mini Cabi, routine wiping with non-abrasive surface disinfectants formulated for clinical environments should be performed at the end of each shift. The powder-coated metallic exterior provides exceptional scratch and stain resistance, ensuring pristine operational condition across a 15-to-20-year lifespan. Consistent care prevents moisture buildup and maintains optimal reflection inside the chamber.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Place the unit on a flat, stable treatment trolley or counter and plug it into a standard certified outlet.
Dampen 6 facial towels (13" x 24"), wring out excess water, roll them neatly, and place them inside the internal wire rack.
Close the door securely and flip the main power switch to initiate automatic 80°C heating and internal UV sterilization.
Open the cabinet during treatments to retrieve warm towels as needed, ensuring the door is closed immediately to retain internal heat.
Turn off the power switch, remove any remaining towels, empty the lower condensation drip tray, and wipe down the interior dry.
Ensure towels are damp but not dripping wet before loading to prevent water buildup around heating elements.
Use tongs or thermal gloves when handling hot towels directly from the chamber to avoid skin burns.
Avoid staring directly into the UV lamp when opening the cabinet door during active operation.
